## 更新内容

- 修复包含已支持卡片、分栏或流程布局的 ChatGPT 对话因“不支持的 HTML 内容”而无法保存的问题。
- 布局按阅读顺序转换为 Markdown，保留正文、代码缩进、图片和方向箭头；颜色和并排样式不保留。
- 引用优先还原来源链接；无法解析时保留原标记并明确标注。未知 HTML 仍会停止保存。
- 保留完整分支校验、图片下载校验和提交前内容变化检查。

### 安装或更新

下载 **`ai-inbox-browser-0.5.4.zip`** 并解压，将文件覆盖到原扩展目录。在 Chrome / Edge 扩展管理页点击“重新加载”，再刷新聊天页面。首次安装请开启开发者模式，加载包含 `manifest.json` 的 `ai-inbox-browser` 目录。保留原目录即可继续使用已有配对。

ChatGPT 兼容 Obsidian 插件 0.3.0+；Gemini / Claude 需要 0.5.0+。建议通过 BRAT 更新到 [Obsidian 插件 0.5.1](https://github.com/elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.1)，同步获取渲染适配。协议保持兼容，无需删除笔记或重新配对。

## What's new

- Fix unsupported-HTML failures for ChatGPT conversations containing supported cards, columns or flow layouts.
- Convert layouts to Markdown in reading order, retaining text, code indentation, images and directional arrows. Colors and side-by-side styling are not retained.
- Resolve citations from source metadata; retain unresolved markers with an explicit label. Unknown HTML still stops the save.
- Keep complete-branch validation, image verification and the final source-change check.

Download **`ai-inbox-browser-0.5.4.zip`**, replace files in the existing extension folder, click Reload in Chrome / Edge, and refresh the chat. For a first installation, enable Developer mode and load the `ai-inbox-browser` folder containing `manifest.json`. Keep the existing folder to retain pairing.

Requires Obsidian plugin 0.3.0+ for ChatGPT, or 0.5.0+ for Gemini / Claude. Updating through BRAT to [Obsidian plugin 0.5.1](https://github.com/elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.1) is recommended for matching renderer support. The protocol remains compatible; no note deletion or re-pairing is required.

Alpha · Chrome 120+ / Chromium-based Microsoft Edge · Obsidian desktop required.
